title: ArmRun
description: One arm reviewing one case: what ran, what came back, what it cost, and how every published finding was graded. The union of these records over a corpus version is the complete input to every published aggregate.

run_id.description: Stable identifier unique across the benchmark.

reviewer.description: Engine name (self-hosted arm) or third-party product name.

model.description: Exact model identifier and endpoint, where applicable.

prompt_hash.description: Hash of the published prompt text this run used.

prompt_ref.description: Path to the published prompt, under results/<corpus>/prompts/.

config.description: Every reviewer tunable that was set, as key/value.

plan_tier.description: Third-party arms only: the commercial plan the install used.

outcome.description: The engine's own timeout/refusal/error is a result (graded as a miss), not an infrastructure failure; infrastructure failures are re-run and not published as outcomes.

raw_output_ref.description: Path to the unedited engine output, exactly as produced.

envelope.description: Parsed report for completed runs; conforms to finding-envelope.schema.json.

telemetry.description: Only fields the engine actually reports are present; 'cost_usd' requires provenance 'authoritative' or 'modeled' — absent means not reported, never zero.

provenance.description: authoritative = reported by the engine/provider; modeled = computed from a published pricing table (recorded with the results).

grades.description: One entry per published finding, plus a case-level catch verdict on bug cases. Graders were blind to arm identity; all grader judgments are retained.

finding_ref.description: 'findings/<i>', 'context_findings/<i>', or 'case' for the case-level catch verdict (bug cases only: caught / location-hit-description-miss / missed).

note.description: One-line justification; adjudication notes included when graders disagreed.
